about: Battery fires and recalls in electric buses, trucks and storage systems: what happened, the stated cause and any lesson published. Causes are as reported; many investigations are still open.

rows.what: Fully electric air-conditioned bus caught fire while moving; 17 passengers evacuated safely
Fire in a lithium-ion container at a 7.5 MW / 7.5 MWh site; no injuries
Bus gutted on route with about 15 passengers, all safe; about the fifth e-bus fire in Delhi since 2022
rows.lesson: The driver's battery cut-off switch reduced the fire in the under-chassis packs; recommended: BMS with real-time temperature monitoring (AIS-156), wiring checks after any impact, lithium-ion extinguishing agents

rows.what: Bus completely gutted; about 50 passengers evacuated safely
rows.cause: Preliminary: short circuit in the electrical system or battery compartment; formal investigation under way

rows.what: Fire near the high-voltage battery system; no injuries
rows.cause: Not confirmed; battery system under investigation
